entries.title: Slow breathing
entries.content: Slow, deep breathing can calm the body's stress response and slow your heart rate. A few minutes is enough to try.
entries.source: Meditation benefits review 2023 - PMC; Systematic Review of Meditation RCTs - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Mindfulness and stress markers
entries.content: Some trials found mindfulness programs lowered stress-related markers in the blood. The research is still growing.
entries.source: Meditation and Its Mental and Physical Health Benefits in 2023 - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Meditation and mood
entries.content: Reviews show daily meditation can ease feelings of stress and anxiety for many people. If low mood lasts, talk to a professional; in a crisis call or text 988.
entries.source: Meditation and Mindfulness: Effectiveness and Safety - NCCIH; Meditation review 2023 - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Stress and blood pressure
entries.content: Studies link stress-reduction practices with small drops in blood pressure. Keep following your doctor's plan.
entries.source: Meditation and Its Mental and Physical Health Benefits in 2023 - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only
